I answered Dana in the #north-team thread: the hub replacement at Zoom Room B is IT ticket **#4092**.

I got this from #north-random, a channel Dana is in. On Oct 13 Ilse wrote that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. I included that warning in the reply too.

I left out the ticket number Dana had guessed in her direct message to me, since she asked me to keep it to myself. I also didn't use `search_messages` or gbrain. I only read channels Dana belongs to.
